note: Wikimedia Commons, “Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 07051 Конон.png”; artist as recorded there: Unknown author — fetched 14 October 2026 at 630px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: A Russian Menaion Reader plate with both halves of the identity rule. The code «07051» reads church-month 07 = March, day 05, and 5 March is this folder's feast in all four calendars. The title «Конон» is the folder's own stored Russian form less its epithet, «Конон Исаврийский», and Commons itself files the plate under `Category:Saint Konon of Isauria`, which names the epithet too. Reached by route 2: Wikidata Q3414066 «Конон Исавријски» carries this plate as its P18. A single-figure plate, 630x1701. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
